cases.name: shared-factory
cases.description: concurrent calls for the same key share one factory invocation

cases.name: independent-keys
cases.description: different keys run independent factory calls

cases.name: inflight-state
cases.description: isInflight returns true while in-flight, false after resolution

cases.name: factory-error-cleanup
cases.description: factory error propagates and entry is cleaned up

cases.name: factory-throw
cases.description: factory throw propagates and entry is cleaned up

cases.name: sequential-calls
cases.description: sequential calls after resolution each trigger a new factory call

cases.name: coalesce-start-hooks
cases.description: onCoalesceStart fires once for leader, onCoalesceJoin fires for each joiner

cases.name: start-gate
cases.description: reserves the shared completion while onCoalesceStart is pending and invokes the factory only after it completes

cases.name: settled-success
cases.description: onCoalesceSettled fires with success=true on resolution

cases.name: settled-failure
cases.description: onCoalesceSettled fires with success=false on rejection

cases.name: join-hook-rejects
cases.description: a rejecting onCoalesceJoin hook rejects the joiner without disturbing the leader's in-flight result

cases.name: no-timeout
cases.description: no timeout configured: run() waits indefinitely, behaves exactly as before

cases.name: timeout-rejects
cases.description: timeout configured on a slow factory rejects the timed-out caller with CoalesceTimeoutError and fires onTimeout

cases.name: timeout-second-caller
cases.description: a second caller joining after the first times out still receives the real result once the factory settles, proving the shared in-flight promise was undisturbed

cases.name: async-timeout-hook
cases.description: an async onTimeout rejection rejects only that caller with HookInvocationError and never becomes unhandled

cases.name: rejecting-start-hook
cases.description: a rejecting onCoalesceStart hook rejects the reserved leader and joiner without invoking the factory

cases.name: throwing-settled-hook
cases.description: a throwing onCoalesceSettled hook replaces the factory outcome with HookInvocationError for every caller sharing the in-flight promise
